path.description: Directory where the plugin writes its generated code, resolved against the global `output.path` set on `defineConfig`. With `mode: 'file'`, this is the full output file path and must include the extension (e.g. `'types.ts'`, `'models.py'`).

mode.description: How generated code is consolidated into files. `'file'` writes everything into a single file, `'directory'` writes one file per operation or schema under `path`. Defaults to `'file'` when `path` carries an extension and `'directory'` when it does not.

banner.description: Text prepended to every generated file. Useful for license headers, lint disables, or `@ts-nocheck` directives. Pass a function to compute the banner from the file's `BannerMeta`.

footer.description: Text appended at the end of every generated file. Pass a function to compute the footer from the file's `BannerMeta`.

type.description: Export strategy for the plugin's barrel files. `'all'` uses wildcard exports, `'named'` uses explicit exports.

nested.description: Generate an `index.ts` in every sub-directory, each re-exporting only what's directly inside it.

barrel.description: Barrel configuration for this plugin's output. Set to `{ type: 'named' | 'all' }` to opt into a barrel, or `false` to disable it. Falls back to `config.output.barrel` when omitted.

output.description: Output configuration shared by every plugin.

type.description: Property used to assign each operation to a group. `'tag'` uses the first tag, `'path'` uses the first segment of the operation's URL.

name.description: Returns the subdirectory name from the group key. Defaults to the camelCased tag for `tag` groups, or the first path segment as written in the spec for `path` groups.

group.description: Groups generated files into subdirectories based on an OpenAPI tag or path segment.
